title: Console launch kit for cost transparency, rollout controls, and enablement
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a cross-functional launch kit for the Console features: the new Cost Breakdown dashboard, Rollouts (canary/A-B/fallback), and rollout literacy materials for internal and customer-facing audiences. Deliverables include coordinated release notes, a support runbook, sales/SE enablement, and a public release notice.
scope: Deliver launch assets and coordinate cross-team timelines for GA of cost transparency and rollout controls in the Console. Includes release notes, in-product help text, internal playbook, live training sessions, and update to the onboarding checklist.
out_of_scope: Major UX changes post-GA, dedicated migration tooling for large enterprise customers (handled as separate migration project), deep billing system integrations beyond displayed cost breakdowns.
goals: Ensure all GTM stakeholders understand feature behavior and limitations
Minimize support volume spikes during first 30 days after GA
Provide clear, correct public release notes and in-console guidance
Enable Sales & SEs to demonstrate cost savings and rollout controls value
success_metrics: <20% increase in Support tickets related to cost visibility in first 30 days
>=80% attendance rate for scheduled enablement sessions among Sales/SE invitees
Documentation and release notes published at least 48h before GA
Customer NPS or in-product survey: >=4/5 usefulness for cost dashboard (sample)

tasks: Collect final copy from Eng for any caveats and rate-limit behavior (owner: ENG)
Lock screenshots and animated GIFs for release notes (owner: DES)
Write Support runbook with triage steps and escalation matrix (owner: Support)
Create Sales/SE demo scripts that highlight cost-savings levers (owner: GTM)
Publish release notes to docs site and pin in Console release modal (owner: Docs + Eng)
Schedule and record three enablement sessions across APAC, EMEA, and NA (owner: PM)
Prepare two short walkthrough videos (1: cost dashboard; 2: rollouts) for Hub (owner: DX)
Coordinate with Billing team for FAQ on cost attribution (owner: Billing)
Set in-console survey to collect early feedback for 30 days post-GA (owner: Product Analytics)
Update onboarding checklist for new tenants to include cost dashboard walkthrough (owner: Ops)
Draft fallback messaging and outage comms template (owner: PM)
Ensure telemetry flags are enabled for rollout visibility and alerts (owner: ENG)
Prepare sample release notes for customers on dedicated plans with guidance for Dedicated/Private users (owner: PM)
Coordinate with Legal on any required public statements for customers in regulated industries (owner: Legal)
Publish internal TL;DR in #product-announcements and pin in Console Slack channel (owner: PM)
Run a pre-GA tabletop with Support, SRE, and Oncall to rehearse escalations (owner: Reliability)
Collect final sign-offs from Design and Security prior to publishing (owner: PM)
risks: Screenshots may diverge if small UI tweaks land after copy freeze — mitigated by a final content freeze 72h before publish
Support load if rollout semantics are misunderstood — mitigated via runbook and demo scripts
Dedicated/private customers require different release cadence — mitigated by pre-signed customer notices and migration guidance
Telemetry gaps could hide regressions — mitigated by pre-GA telemetry checklist and SRE tabletop
communication_plan: T-minus 7 days: Internal pre-announce via all-hands notes + #product-announcements
T-minus 3 days: Publish docs and release notes draft to public beta docs with 'beta' flag
T-minus 48h: Pin release notes and enablement deck in Slack; notify Sales leadership
GA day: Post blog + in-console modal; email to active customers with concise summary and links
Post-GA day 7: Follow-up email with top tips and known issues; invite to feedback session
training_plan: Run three live 45-minute sessions (EMEA/NA/APAC) with Q&A; record for on-demand
Publish two 5-minute walkthrough videos focused on cost insights and rollout staging
Create a one-page cheat sheet for Support and Sales with quick commands and expected behavior
Host an optional hands-on lab for SEs to practice migrating a demo tenant to use rollouts
Add a short quiz in the enablement Hub to measure knowledge transfer (target >=80% pass)
release_notes_summary: GA: Cost Breakdown dashboard (per-route and per-token attribution) + Rollouts (canary/A-B/fallback) with Console controls. Docs include examples, limitations, and billing notes. Recommended for teams seeking predictable inference costs and safer deployments.
